main_text.l: communicant qui sermonem illum Domini,
quem tradiderūt Apostoli, prout à Christo ac-
cepērant, præferunt in ouili eius. Ambulent
sanè alij in vocatione sua sibi ipsis,id est, suo &
paucorum, quibus sunt coniuncti, commodo:
at nos quibus dispensatio bonorum istorum
suit concredita, siue stamus, siue cadimus,non
solùm Domino nostro & nobis(vt alij)stamus,
aut cadimus ;sed aliis quàm plurimis, qui no-
bis labentibus collabuntur & confistunt stan-
tibus. Optima quæque de omnibus concipio,
& opto ex animo : cùm tamen ex prisHcis recen-
tibusque exemplis incommoda plurima Eccle-
siis allata videam imprudente multorum ad-
ministratione , qui nec dignitatem sermonis
diuini, nec veritatem vocationis suæ , nec pa-
cem Ecclesiæ satis prudenter expenderunt, da-
bitis veniant pro vestra in Deum Ecclesiamque
pietate , si postquā de omnibus Ecclesiæ mem-
bris in communedixi, aliquid etiam speciatim
de iis dixero,qui communi corpori Ecclesiæ ex
vocatione Dei tenentur consulere; vt pastores
in ea dati, ad coagmentationem sanctorum,ad
opus ministerij , & ad ædificationem corpo-
ris Christi.
Est igitur munus commune omnium, vt
communionem sanctorum colant, & pacem
expetant, illius: nostrum verò singulare est, vt
eandem communione colamus singulari modo,
qui singulari vocationis lege à Deo prœfinitus est.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout, per rule. The printed "fuit" and "eft" are read as "suit" and "est" under that rule; the printed f in "prifcis" is read as "prisHcis" in a line-end in error—see below. Doubtful: "prisHcis" should read "priscis"; the letter after "pri" is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The asterisk in the left margin is a reference mark with no note text. The foot mark at the bottom is unclear and was given only as an illegible gathering mark. Printed "communedixi" and "dixero" kept as printed. Printed hyphens at line ends kept.
